categories.name: What a lake does for us
What lakes get paved over into

fun_fact: At its peak, Bengaluru had 1,400+ lakes and water bodies, which became the city's lifeline. But over the last few decades, this story changed - From around 1,452 water bodies in the 1800s, it fell to about 285 lakes by the 1970s and 194 by 2016. Today, BBMP data shows that ONLY 183! [See more](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hfzGWty8oRI&t=3s)
